# Nines

> Nines is an open-source, self-hosted service level objective (SLO) platform. It connects SLOs and critical user journeys as versioned YAML, measures with Prometheus or Mimir and experimental Datadog, New Relic, VictoriaMetrics, Dash0 and Google Cloud adapters, and provides a portal, deterministic CLI, Go client, Kubernetes operator and tenant-scoped MCP tools.

Nines is a pre-release MVP. Model-assisted intent workflows are experimental and optional. Agents can prepare proposals; humans review measurements and approve exact changes. A saved SLO or uploaded rule is not proof of healthy telemetry or rule evaluation.

## Start here

- [How to define an SLO](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/slo-guide/): SLIs, good and eligible events, rolling windows, error budgets, examples and review.
- [Documentation](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/): Product setup and guides.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/ishantanu/nines): Code, examples, issues and license.
- [Full documentation text](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/llms-full.txt): Generated from the published documentation.

## SLO use cases

- [SLOs and measurements](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/measurements/): Define an SLI, target and window.
- [Latency SLOs](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/latency-slos/): Histogram buckets, threshold ratios and percentiles.
- [Critical user journeys](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/critical-user-journeys/): Link SLOs to user outcomes.
- [Agent, LLM and inference SLOs](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/agent-slos/): Task, rubric and serving measurements.
- [SLI menus and templates](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/slo-templates/): Editable starting points.

## Interfaces and deployment

- [HTTP API](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/api/): Tenant-scoped authentication and common endpoints.
- [OpenAPI contract](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/openapi/v1alpha1.yaml): Versioned partial contract for SLO and reviewed intent operations.
- [CLI](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/cli/): Offline validation and rule generation; tenant-scoped connected commands.
- [MCP](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/mcp/): Scoped agent tools and review boundaries.
- [GitHub reviews](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/github-reviews/): Explicitly publish a reviewed snapshot for a chosen PR commit; no SLO approval or application.
- [Headless workflows](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/headless-workflows/): Preparation, independent review, application, verification and rollback.
- [Prometheus and Mimir](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/deployment/metrics-and-rules/): Query authentication, tenant mapping and rule delivery.
- [Kubernetes operator](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/deployment/operator/): Reconcile SLO definitions and rules.
- [Model evaluation](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/intent-evaluations/): Provider-neutral synthetic evaluation and documented limitations.

- Telemetry providers: https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/provider-adapters/

- [Remote MCP with OAuth](https://ishantanu.github.io/nines/docs/remote-mcp/): stateless Streamable HTTP, per-client/user scope bindings, setup and verified limitations.
